            - Faulty solar radiation sensor was replaced at noon on 
              Oct 10 (d=284).  All solar radation data that was  
              reported prior to this date/time was removed from  
              the database.  Solar data during the following time 
              period was marked as "missing": 
 
                  08/19/08 (d=232) 00:05 - 10/10/08 (d=284) 12:00
